---
title: "xtmeta"
---

## Description

Creates a zero record dataset based on a dataset metadata spreadsheet.

Also creates a global macro variable called &dsname.KEEPSTRING.

## Parameters

**`dsname`**

: Dataset to look for in the metadata file

  *Required:* Yes

**`filename`**

: Name of the CSV file with metadata. Determined automatically if empty

  *Required:* No

**`filepath`**

: Full path to CSV file with metadata

  *Required:* No

**`qc`**

: Flag that changes all character variables length to 200

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xtmeta(ADSL);
%xtmeta(AE);
```
